verdict.rationale: Jira's own feature page says it connects engineering, product, and marketing initiatives to coordinate big launches across every team, and offers a timeline view for tracking progress. However, nothing in the evidence explicitly describes dependency tracking itself, such as linking blocking work across teams or visualizing dependencies on the timeline. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of cross-team dependency linking or visualization, dependency risk or blocker surfacing, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can track cross-team dependencies to coordinate large launches

citations.quote: Connect engineering, product, and marketing initiatives to coordinate big launches across every team.
